rules.statement: Sites at or above this elevation count as high altitude, where appliance manuals commonly call for a taller chimney.
Factory-built chimneys are installed per their listing and the manufacturer instructions; the listing governs clearances.
rules.source_ref: NFPA 211 (edition adopted by AHJ) - section to confirm

rules.statement: A chimney connector may not pass through a ceiling, floor, attic or concealed space; the listed chimney must start below such penetrations.
rules.source_ref: NFPA 211 (edition adopted by AHJ) - section to confirm

rules.statement: A connector passing through a combustible wall must use a listed pass-through system or an approved method.
rules.source_ref: NFPA 211 (edition adopted by AHJ) - section to confirm

rules.statement: Connector runs rise toward the chimney at a minimum slope.
rules.source_ref: NFPA 211 (edition adopted by AHJ) - section to confirm

rules.statement: Horizontal connector length is limited relative to the vertical chimney height above it.
rules.source_ref: NFPA 211 (edition adopted by AHJ) - section to confirm

rules.statement: Unlisted single-wall connector clearance to combustibles, absent a listed reduction.
rules.source_ref: NFPA 211 (edition adopted by AHJ) - section to confirm

rules.statement: Chimney flue may not be smaller than the appliance flue collar.
rules.source_ref: NFPA 211 (edition adopted by AHJ) - section to confirm

rules.statement: Termination height rule (3 ft above penetration / 2 ft above anything within 10 ft).
rules.source_ref: NFPA 211 (edition adopted by AHJ) - section to confirm

rules.statement: Re-support the chimney above an offset where the chimney maker's instructions call for it.
rules.source_ref: Planner default; a line that requires it sets 1

rules.statement: Where the chimney is boxed in through the attic, follow the chimney maker's instructions for venting the enclosure.
